name: 蛇河雨林 · 3v3
description: 横贯中央的S型河将雨林分成南北两岸，西、中、东三处渡口连接大片林区，桥头零散遗迹提供掩护。

en.name: Serpentine Rainforest · 3v3
en.description: A horizontal S-shaped river divides dense rainforest into two banks, linked by three offset crossings and scattered bridgehead ruins.
